pk: srivyasatirTa: vyasa-‘aDyatnayogena’” iti Bagavato Dyananuktan sa kutra Dyeya ityata aha- rtaniti sukrtasya punyasya karye sarire pancagnayo devayajanadayo yesan te taTokta 1.3.1 vya.Ba- "rtan pibantO” ityetatkEsvidbudDijivaparatvena anyErjivesvara- visayatvena vyaKyatan tana suKaBoktrtvanupapate suKasyEva Boktrtvanupapatescetyasayavan yaTavadvyacaswe - atneti atna dehahrdaye sTita antaratna jivahrdaye sTita a rdDa ardDa pareByopyarDa pararDa tasnin pareByopyrdDarupake parane guhan praviswe vayO viBurvisnu sa eka evatnantaratneti dviDa sTita asO Bujyanta iti Boga visaya suBaneva Bogan pibatyanuBavati rtan pibantavuBavapi paranatnani cetkaTan Cayatapatvanityatastadvyacaswe - Cayeti 1.3.1
ck: srivyasatirta: vyasa-‘atyatnayokena’” iti pakavato tyananuktan sa kutra tyeya ityata aha- rtaniti sukrtasya punyasya karye sarire pancaknayo tevayacanatayo yesan te tatokta 1.3.1 vya.pa- "rtan pipantO” ityetatkEsvitputicivaparatvena anyErcivesvara- visayatvena vyakyatan tana sukapoktrtvanupapate sukasyEva poktrtvanupapatescetyasayavan yatavatvyacaste - atneti atna tehahrtaye stita antaratna civahrtaye stita a rta arta parepyopyarta pararta tasnin parepyopyrtarupake parane kuhan praviste vayO vipurvisnu sa eka evatnantaratneti tvita stita asO pucyanta iti poka visaya supaneva pokan pipatyanupavati rtan pipantavupavapi paranatnani cetkatan cayatapatvanityatastatvyacaste - cayeti 1.3.1
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: व्यास-‘अध्यात्मयोगेन’” इति भगवतो ध्यानमुक्तम् स कुत्र ध्येय इत्यत आह- ऋतमिति सुकृतस्य पुण्यस्य कार्ये शरीरे पञ्चाग्नयो देवयज

pk: srivyasatirTa: BagavadDyanasyahatya saDanan kinityato Bagavantan stuvan tadvaktun sakrana ityaha- yaseturiti setutvadigunakan Dyatun saDanan vaktun saknuna ityarTa 1.3.2 vya.Ba- ‘ya seturijananan" ityetadvyacaswe - naryadeti 1.3.2 wika- naryada ityadina ya setu ityaderaBiprayanaha atra ekavacanena parabrahnatvadiBisca visesanat visnureva pibantaviti Bava sansaranadin titirsatan aBayan paran visnvarupan brahna evan sangrahenoktan naciketagnisTan harin kincidvistarena ca vaktun vayan taTa kincit saknuna nahi srotun saknosityuparanyate 1.3.2 "
ck: srivyasatirta: pakavatyanasyahatya satanan kinityato pakavantan stuvan tatvaktun sakrana ityaha- yaseturiti setutvatikunakan tyatun satanan vaktun saknuna ityarta 1.3.2 vya.pa- ‘ya seturicananan" ityetatvyacaste - naryateti 1.3.2 tika- naryata ityatina ya setu ityaterapiprayanaha atra ekavacanena paraprahnatvatipisca visesanat visnureva pipantaviti pava sansaranatin titirsatan apayan paran visnvarupan prahna evan sankrahenoktan naciketaknistan harin kincitvistarena ca vaktun vayan tata kincit saknuna nahi srotun saknosityuparanyate 1.3.2 "
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: भगवद्ध्यानस्याहत्य साधनं किमित्यतो भगवन्तं स्तुवन् तद्वक्तुं शक्रम इत्याह- यस्सेतुरिति सेतुत्वादिगुणकं ध्यातुं साधनं वक्तुं

pk: srivyasatirTa: aByarhitan pratyaharan nirupayati- atnananityadina pragrahan dana 1.3.3 asvadinan granadiniva tesu tesan gocaranvisayanahu atna atnanan 1.3.4 santvatnadayo raTyadirupa taTaca kinityata aha- ya iti vijnanavan budDiyuta 1.3.6 Dyanasya pratyaharoByarhitan saDanan kuta ityatastadrahitasya tadvatasca kranenanarTaPale aha- yastvityadina 1.3.7-8 " sa tu tatpadan" iti tacCabdenoktan kinityata aha - vijnaneti 1.3.9
ck: srivyasatirta: apyarhitan pratyaharan nirupayati- atnananityatina prakrahan tana 1.3.3 asvatinan kranatiniva tesu tesan kocaranvisayanahu atna atnanan 1.3.4 santvatnatayo ratyatirupa tataca kinityata aha- ya iti vicnanavan putiyuta 1.3.6 tyanasya pratyaharopyarhitan satanan kuta ityatastatrahitasya tatvatasca kranenanartapale aha- yastvityatina 1.3.7-8 " sa tu tatpatan" iti tacaptenoktan kinityata aha - vicnaneti 1.3.9
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: अभ्यर्हितं प्रत्याहारं निरूपयति- आत्मानमित्यादिना प्रग्रहं दाम १.३.३ अश्वादीनां ग्रामादीनिव तेषु तेषां गोचरान्विषयानाहुः आत्

pk: srivyasatirTa: BagavadDyananca taratanyantargatatvena karyanityaha- indriyeBya ityadina vya. Ba- “ indriyeBya para" ityadivakyan prasidDendriyaparatvapratitin nivarayan vyacaswe - deveBya iti ke te indriyadeva iti jijnasayanaha - soneti srotratvakcaksurasanaGranavagGastapadapayupasTananindriyanan kranatsonadayo deva isa ityarTa arTadevata aha- suparniti nanu rupadaya pancarTa sOparnyadyastu tisra ata kaTan tasanarTaviBaga ityata uktan- dvidvyekadevata iti dvO ca dvO ca ekasca dvibyeke tesan devata dvivyekadevata suparnivarunyO dvayordvayoraBinaninyO unatvekasyetyarTa kasWa avasanan para gati paranaprapyan “purusana paran" ityade- statparyarTanaha- nEveti 1.3.10-1
ck: srivyasatirta: pakavatyananca taratanyantarkatatvena karyanityaha- intriyepya ityatina vya. pa- “ intriyepya para" ityativakyan prasitentriyaparatvapratitin nivarayan vyacaste - tevepya iti ke te intriyateva iti cicnasayanaha - soneti srotratvakcaksurasanakranavakastapatapayupastananintriyanan kranatsonatayo teva isa ityarta artatevata aha- suparniti nanu rupataya pancarta sOparnyatyastu tisra ata katan tasanartavipaka ityata uktan- tvitvyekatevata iti tvO ca tvO ca ekasca tvipyeke tesan tevata tvivyekatevata suparnivarunyO tvayortvayorapinaninyO unatvekasyetyarta kasta avasanan para kati paranaprapyan “purusana paran" ityate- statparyartanaha- nEveti 1.3.10-1
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: भगवद्ध्यानञ्च तारतम्यान्तर्गतत्वेन कार्यमित्याह- इन्द्रियेभ्य इत्यादिना व्या. भा- “ इन्द्रियेभ्यः पराः" इत्यादिवाक्यं प्रसिद

pk: srivyasatirTa: vyasa - sarvaga kascidasti cetkasnatsa na drsyata ityata aha- esa iti na drsyate cedalan tadarsanarTan prayasenetyata aha- drsyata iti 1.3.12
ck: srivyasatirta: vyasa - sarvaka kascitasti cetkasnatsa na trsyata ityata aha- esa iti na trsyate cetalan tatarsanartan prayasenetyata aha- trsyata iti 1.3.12
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: व्यास - सर्वगः कश्चिदस्ति चेत्कस्मात्स न दृश्यत इत्यत आह- एष इति न दृश्यते चेदलं तद्दर्शनार्थं प्रयासेनेत्यत आह- दृश्यत इति

pk: srivyasatirTa: indriyadiByorTadaya utanatvena Dyeya ityuktan na kelanutanatvena kintu purvapurvesan utarotaraniyatatvanca Dyeyanityaha- yacCediti indriyani vaci niyacCet, vacan nanasi, nanasca jnane budDO sante atisayitasuKarupe 1.3.13 vya. Ba- yacCedityadi vyacaswe - tasnaditi tasnaduktaprakarena taratanyaBavaditi vagatnika vagaBinanini indriyani vaci niyacCat ityadO grahyan indriyadinanarTadisu niyananan nana kinityata aha- tadvasatveneti naparo niyananarupa prasidDaniyananarTatve baDakanaha- kuta iti 1.3.13
ck: srivyasatirta: intriyatipyortataya utanatvena tyeya ityuktan na kelanutanatvena kintu purvapurvesan utarotaraniyatatvanca tyeyanityaha- yacetiti intriyani vaci niyacet, vacan nanasi, nanasca cnane putO sante atisayitasukarupe 1.3.13 vya. pa- yacetityati vyacaste - tasnatiti tasnatuktaprakarena taratanyapavatiti vakatnika vakapinanini intriyani vaci niyacat ityatO krahyan intriyatinanartatisu niyananan nana kinityata aha- tatvasatveneti naparo niyananarupa prasitaniyananartatve patakanaha- kuta iti 1.3.13
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: इन्द्रियादिभ्योऽर्थादय उत्तमत्वेन ध्येया इत्युक्तम् न केलमुत्तमत्वेन किन्तु पूर्वपूर्वेषां उत्तरोत्तरनियतत्वञ्च ध्येयमित्याह

pk: srivyasatirTa: vedapurusa svayan saDunan hitanupadisati utisWateti kinarTan boDa sanpadaniya sansrtinivrtyarTaniti cena tasya karanantarenanayasena nivrtO prayasasaDyaboDabEyarTyadityata aha- ksurasyeti sansrti ksurasya Dareva nisita nisitatvaneva vivaritunuktan - duratyayeti tanivartakan paTascarciradinargadganyan durganiti kavayo vadanti 1.3.14
ck: srivyasatirta: vetapurusa svayan satunan hitanupatisati utistateti kinartan pota sanpataniya sansrtinivrtyartaniti cena tasya karanantarenanayasena nivrtO prayasasatyapotapEyartyatityata aha- ksurasyeti sansrti ksurasya tareva nisita nisitatvaneva vivaritunuktan - turatyayeti tanivartakan patascarciratinarkatkanyan turkaniti kavayo vatanti 1.3.14
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: वेदपुरुषः स्वयं साधूनां हितमुपदिशति उत्तिष्ठतेति किमर्थं बोधः सम्पादनीयः संसृतिनिवृत्त्यर्थमिति चेन्न तस्याः कारणान्तरेणानाय

pk: srivyasatirTa: vya- durganatvan brahnana kaTanityata sabdadyanatnakatvena srotradya- visayatvadityaha- asabdaniti sansaranivrtisaDanan tajnanan kena saDaniyanityata aha- anaditi srotradyagocaranapi nahata paratvadirupena sastrato nicaya jnatva nrtyunuKatpranucyate 1.3.15 vya.Ba- anadyanantanavyaktatparaniti vaktavye nahata paranityukte karananaha- sveti
ck: srivyasatirta: vya- turkanatvan prahnana katanityata saptatyanatnakatvena srotratya- visayatvatityaha- asaptaniti sansaranivrtisatanan tacnanan kena sataniyanityata aha- anatiti srotratyakocaranapi nahata paratvatirupena sastrato nicaya cnatva nrtyunukatpranucyate 1.3.15 vya.pa- anatyanantanavyaktatparaniti vaktavye nahata paranityukte karananaha- sveti
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: व्या- दुर्गमत्वं ब्रह्मणः कथमित्यतः शब्दाद्यनात्मकत्वेन श्रोत्राद्य- विषयत्वादित्याह- अशब्दमिति संसारनिवृत्तिसाधनं तज्ज्ञानं

s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: अत्राध्यायस्य समाप्तत्वादुक्तविद्यां श्रुत्वा वक्तुः फलमाह- नाचिकेतमिति १.३.१६

pk: srivyasatirTa: vyasa - punarapi brahnavidyan vaktunaDyayantaratvenaDikararTan dusanpadyanapi vEragyanavasyan sanpadyanityaha - paranciti Kani indriyani atnanontarna pasyati pratyak anta 2.1.1 vya. ck: srivyasatirta: vyasa - punarapi prahnavityan vaktunatyayantaratvenatikarartan tusanpatyanapi vErakyanavasyan sanpatyanityaha - paranciti kani intriyani atnanontarna pasyati pratyak anta 2.1.1 vya. pa- kevalanirnanartapratitin nivarayan “vyatrnat" ityetatatu- vyakyanena vyacaste - trnviti trnu tatu katkarane kutsitakarane vartate iti tatu tatuvyakyananityarta 2.1.1
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: व्यास - पुनरपि ब्रह्मविद्यां वक्तुमध्यायान्तरत्वेनाधिकारार्थं दुस्सम्पाद्यमपि वैराग्यमवश्यं सम्पाद्यमित्याह - पराञ्चीति खानि

pk: srivyasatirTa: avilanbena tatvan nirupayeti puna prcCati yeneti yenEvEtena sansare rupadin vijanati, tadetadatra noksepi niyanakan parisisyate kiniti prasnavakyarTa yadetaniyanakan noksepi parisisyate kiniti prswan tadetanoksepi parisisyate vE iti pariharanaha- etadvE taditi 2.1.3 vya.Ba- ‘“hanta ta idan pravaksyani " ityetatpurvatra sanbaDyata ityasayavan atna jivo naranan prapya yaTa yadBavati tadbrahnetyanyaTapratitin nivarayan vyacaswe - idaniti jivasya narananantaran yadBavati taca vaksyaniti kinarTanaprswarTapratijna kriyata ityata aha- jiva iti nunuksorjivesvara- vElaksanyajnananavasyakan tajnapanayaprswarTapratijna krtetyarTa jivesvara- Bedajnapanaya pratijna cedutaratra tayorvEDarnyakti syaditi vadata tawasTasyoktan vEDarnyanityaha- ya iti ya karnaPalaBokteti “yoninanye prapadyante” ityasyarTa ‘“ya esu suptesu" ityasyarTa ya pralayadisviti atna naranan prapya yaTa yadBavati tadbrahneti kasnana syadityata aha- nahiti nanu jivesvaraBedajnapananca kinarTan yena tatpratijna sarTaketyata aha- jivaditi tvaya yaTavadbrahna jnatavyanityadavupaskartavyan ata pratijna sarTaketi vakyasesa 2.1.3
ck: srivyasatirta: avilanpena tatvan nirupayeti puna prcati yeneti yenEvEtena sansare rupatin vicanati, tatetatatra noksepi niyanakan parisisyate kiniti prasnavakyarta yatetaniyanakan noksepi parisisyate kiniti prstan tatetanoksepi parisisyate vE iti pariharanaha- etatvE tatiti 2.1.3 vya.pa- ‘“hanta ta itan pravaksyani " ityetatpurvatra sanpatyata ityasayavan atna civo naranan prapya yata yatpavati tatprahnetyanyatapratitin nivarayan vyacaste - itaniti civasya narananantaran yatpavati taca vaksyaniti kinartanaprstartapraticna kriyata ityata aha- civa iti nunuksorcivesvara- vElaksanyacnananavasyakan tacnapanayaprstartapraticna krtetyarta civesvara- petacnapanaya praticna cetutaratra tayorvEtarnyakti syatiti vatata tatastasyoktan vEtarnyanityaha- ya iti ya karnapalapokteti “yoninanye prapatyante” ityasyarta ‘“ya esu suptesu" ityasyarta ya pralayatisviti atna naranan prapya yata yatpavati tatprahneti kasnana syatityata aha- nahiti nanu civesvarapetacnapananca kinartan yena tatpraticna sartaketyata aha- civatiti tvaya yatavatprahna cnatavyanityatavupaskartavyan ata praticna sartaketi vakyasesa 2.1.3
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: अविलम्बेन तत्त्वं निरूपयेति पुनः पृच्छति येनेति येनैवैतेन संसारे रूपादीन् विजानाति, तदेतदत्र मोक्षेऽपि नियामकं परिशिष्यते कि

pk: srivyasatirTa: niyanakan vistarya bruhityakanksayan svapnantanityadina niyanakan brahna vistarenaha- svapnantaniti svapnantanityata purvan ‘hanta ta idan pravaksyani guhyan brahna sanatanan" iti pratijnavakyan draswavyan svapnantan svapnaKyanantan svapnasusupti iti yavat 2.1. 4
ck: srivyasatirta: niyanakan vistarya pruhityakanksayan svapnantanityatina niyanakan prahna vistarenaha- svapnantaniti svapnantanityata purvan ‘hanta ta itan pravaksyani kuhyan prahna sanatanan" iti praticnavakyan trastavyan svapnantan svapnakyanantan svapnasusupti iti yavat 2.1. 4
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: नियामकं विस्तार्य ब्रूहीत्याकाङ्क्षायां स्वप्नान्तमित्यादिना नियामकं ब्रह्म विस्तरेणाह- स्वप्नान्तमिति स्वप्नान्तमित्यतः पूर

pk: srivyasatirTa: vya- naDvadan dehe sTitva saraBoktaran jivanantikat jivasya sanipe tata atnano jnatatvat svatnanan goptun necCati vya.Ba- atnanan jivaniti sananaDikaranyapratitya jivasyatnaBeda pratiyate sa prakrtapratijna virudDotastan nivarayan jivaniti dvitiyan sasWyarTatvena vyakurvan tasyanvayanca darsayati- jivasyeti jivaniti 1. ‘“inan” iti vananatapanqitacaryapaWa dvitiyaya sasWyarTatvanangikare baDakanaha- nahiti hiti sucitanupapatin sPorayanaha - vastvantarasyeti 2.1.5
ck: srivyasatirta: vya- natvatan tehe stitva sarapoktaran civanantikat civasya sanipe tata atnano cnatatvat svatnanan koptun necati vya.pa- atnanan civaniti sananatikaranyapratitya civasyatnapeta pratiyate sa prakrtapraticna virutotastan nivarayan civaniti tvitiyan sastyartatvena vyakurvan tasyanvayanca tarsayati- civasyeti civaniti 1. ‘“inan” iti vananatapantitacaryapata tvitiyaya sastyartatvanankikare patakanaha- nahiti hiti sucitanupapatin sporayanaha - vastvantarasyeti 2.1.5
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: व्या- मध्वदं देहे स्थित्वा सारभोक्तारम् जीवमन्तिकात् जीवस्य समीपे तत आत्मनो ज्ञातत्वात् स्वात्मानं गोप्तुं नेच्छति व्या.भा-

pk: srivyasatirTa: ya purvaniti vakyan durganarTatvadvyacaswe - ananaBya iti guhan pravisyeti vakyan yojanapratitervyacaswe - svatnananiti kasnadapi purvanajatan purvajataniti sucitanarTan svavakyena visadayati- yaTetyadina yaTendradijanakasya kasyapasya na teBya utanatvan na taTa visno brahnana tasya purvajatatajanakatvadutanatvaneveti BavarTa ajayatetyasya svayanutpana ityarTatvat kaTan janayanaseti nijarTataya vyaKyetyata prayogadarsanenopa- padayati- ajayateti 2.1.6
ck: srivyasatirta: ya purvaniti vakyan turkanartatvatvyacaste - ananapya iti kuhan pravisyeti vakyan yocanapratitervyacaste - svatnananiti kasnatapi purvanacatan purvacataniti sucitanartan svavakyena visatayati- yatetyatina yatentraticanakasya kasyapasya na tepya utanatvan na tata visno prahnana tasya purvacatatacanakatvatutanatvaneveti pavarta acayatetyasya svayanutpana ityartatvat katan canayanaseti nicartataya vyakyetyata prayokatarsanenopa- patayati- acayateti 2.1.6
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: यः पूर्वमिति वाक्यं दुर्गमार्थत्वाद्व्याचष्टे - अम्मामभ्य इति गुहां प्रविश्येति वाक्यं योजनाप्रतीतेर्व्याचष्टे - स्वात्मानमि

ck: srivyasatirta: "kuhan pravisya tistantin" ityatra prahnatiputaniyanakatvenatnanan putepirputE saha vyacayata canayanasetyuktan tatra nularupatavatararupanan peto nastityaha- yateveheti uktan petapavan petatarsino petapetatarsinasca anartoktya sanartayate- nrtyoriti 2.1.10 vya.pa- ‘“yateveha’” ityetatyatasnin sarire cEtanyan tatevanutra paratehepi ityanyatapratitin nivarayantryacaste - ya ityatina “nrtyo sa nrtyun ” ityati puna puna cayate nriyate ceti pratitin nivarayan vyacaste - kunata iti anena "neha nana" iti vyakyatan pavati ivasaptartanaha- atyalpanapiti ivasaptasyartantaranaha - petapeteti atra pakavati tatrupesu ca karacaranatyavayavatinan petapetapetatarsinonartakatanan “nrtyo sa nrtyun kacati’” iti tatvyacaste- tatEveti 2.1.10
s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: "गुहां प्रविश्य तिष्ठन्तीम्" इत्यत्र ब्रह्मादिभूतनियामकत्वेनात्मानं भूतेभिर्भूतैः सह व्यजायत जनयामासेत्युक्तं तत्र मूलरूपादव

s: श्रीव्यासतीर्थ: भगवद्गुणानां भगवता भेदाभेददिर्शनोऽनर्थमाह- यथोदकमिति व्या.भा- ‘“यथोदकम्’” इति वाक्यमन्वयाप्रतीतेः व्याचष्टे- पर्वतेष्विति शि
